content: ꞌEnega lami nina yaꞌitena losipwa ꞌebweu ꞌiliꞌamina, ga yobai nidi ꞌediyega ꞌebweu ꞌenana nadigega wepalala yanonona, ꞌigwae, “ꞌUmai.”
ꞌEnega yadunedune ga ꞌebweu osi wakewakekena ꞌiapwesama, ta ꞌana togelu nina ma ina gita be tupu, ta wate ꞌana peyaula esaesa siꞌebwaꞌena. ꞌEnega ꞌitauya ga ꞌilosaiya, ta ꞌiewaiwai.
ꞌEnega lami nina losipwa ꞌeluwena ꞌiliꞌamina, ga wate yobai ꞌeluwena ꞌenana yanonona, ꞌigwae, “ꞌUmai.”

ꞌEnega ꞌebweu osi bweyabweyalina ꞌiapwesama, ta ꞌana togelu nina waiwai siꞌebwaꞌena be saiya ꞌida meꞌe baleꞌuya, be ꞌenega tomota maiboꞌadi taudimo sida losaiya be sida eunuunuwedi, ta wate sisisaiya sinabwana siꞌebwaꞌena.

ꞌEnega lami nina wate losipwa ꞌetonina ꞌiliꞌamina, ta wate yobai ꞌetonina ꞌenana yanonona ꞌigwae, “ꞌUmai.” ꞌEnega yadunedune ga ꞌebweu osi gaigaina ꞌiapwesama, ta ꞌana togelu nina ma ina ꞌebe ꞌetopwapwa masula manuna.
Ga ꞌebweu ꞌatuwa ꞌenana yobai nidi ata gamwagamwanidiyega yanonona, ꞌigwae, “Witi ꞌana ꞌetopwapwa ꞌebweuna ꞌana maisa ꞌebweuna kina, ta wate baꞌali
ꞌana ꞌetopwapwa ꞌetoi ꞌana maisa ꞌebweu kina, ta esi olibe bunamina be oine geyaꞌabo wagitogitoodi.”
ꞌEnega lami nina wate losipwa eatana ꞌiliꞌamina, ga wate yobai eatana ꞌenana yanonona, ꞌigwae, “ꞌUmai.”

ꞌEnega yadunedune ga ꞌebweu osi ꞌana ꞌita ꞌatuwa tupwana wakewakekena ꞌiapwesama. Ta ꞌana togelu nina ꞌana esana Mwawasa, ta wate tomwawasa yaluyaluwadi ꞌidi ꞌasa selabenaya ꞌimulimuliya, ga loina siꞌewena Yaubada ꞌenega be ꞌaene tomota yaudi sida peꞌudi saiyega be botanega be muyega be wate bosasa ꞌediyega, ta nigeya ꞌaene tomota maiboꞌada, ta tuga ꞌabo nadigega baleꞌu maiboꞌana ꞌenaya boda taeguyaiyedi ꞌadi yau ata, ta ꞌebweuna boda ꞌediyega maiboꞌadi sipeꞌudi, be boda ꞌetoi namo situpwa.

ꞌEnega wate lami nina losipwa enimana ꞌiliꞌamina, ga Yaubada ꞌina ꞌebe taliya ꞌubuninaya ꞌana tosimanao yaluyaluwadi yaꞌitedi, taudi lowa baleꞌuya Yaubada ꞌina ona ꞌana tosimanao boboꞌadi, ta gete manuna tomota sietalauwaledi ga siloemwawasidi.

Ta yaluyaluwa nidi ꞌenadi sinabwanega sibwaubwau, sigwae, “ꞌInapwana Toewaiwai sayo, ꞌoyo ꞌesaseyo ta palupaluyo, to tuta ꞌena be ꞌenega ꞌama toloemwawasao baleꞌuya ꞌuda loinedi ꞌidi toꞌumalinao manudi?”

ꞌEnega yaluyaluwa nidi ꞌadi ꞌoamao wakewakekedi ꞌiꞌebwaꞌedi, ga ꞌieonedi be tuta gidalina namo sida eyawaiꞌata, ꞌana laba ꞌaidi wate gosediyao me baleꞌu sida loemwawasidi, nadigega tuga lowa taudi siloemwawasidi Yaubada ꞌina guinuwa manuna, be ꞌenega ꞌabo ꞌadi sawasawa niꞌatu sawesawenaya, ꞌenega Yaubada me baleꞌu nidi ꞌida loinedi.

ꞌEnega lami nina wate losipwa esikisina ꞌiliꞌamina ga mwaniꞌiniꞌi sinabwana ꞌiniuniu, ta sinala ꞌiguguyoi, ꞌana ꞌita ꞌatuwa ꞌule siyasiyana, ta wate nawalae ꞌana ꞌita maiboꞌana bweyabweyalina, lala nadigega,
ta kwadimao galewega sibeꞌuma, ꞌatuwa kaiwe ꞌiuwa ta yagila waiwaina ꞌitowama ga uwanao nidi sisagusaguma.
Ta galewa yaꞌitena ꞌatuwa pwepwai nadigega ꞌiꞌenunumina ga ꞌisawala, ꞌenega ꞌoya be salu ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌadi ꞌautui sipilisinena.
Ta baleꞌu ꞌana ꞌinapwanao be toloinao be saiya ꞌadi ꞌinapwanao be toesaesao be toewaiwaiyao, ta wate toanuganao be ꞌidi topaisewao, maiboꞌadi sidena ꞌoyaya, ga duluwa be gulewa ꞌediya sikwaiya.
ꞌEnega sibwau gulewa be ꞌoya ꞌediya, sigwae, “Wada beꞌuma debamaya, be geyaꞌabo tauna ꞌebemi esaesa ꞌena ꞌimiyatowa ꞌida ꞌitaꞌitama, be wate lami nina geyaꞌabo ꞌida ꞌitaꞌitama.
Manuna lami ꞌina gamwasowala ꞌana ꞌasiyata sinabwana niꞌatu ꞌiapwesama, ta nigeya ꞌebweu yaita sawesawenaya be ꞌiewaiwaisine.”

footnotes.text: baꞌali: masula bagulaya siasona ꞌana ꞌita laisi nai witi nadigega.
